title: Rav Salla Chasida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that no halakhah or aggadah of his remains to him; he is mentioned only through his brother, as in [Berakhot 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.5b.17) and [29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.29b.16): Rav Yehudah, the brother of Rav Salla Chasida (in Rav Huna’s time).
In [Pesachim 73b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.73b.11): Rav Yosef son of Rav Salla Chasida.[^1]

notes.text: The Berakhot passages mention his brother Rav Yehudah. In Pesachim his son Rav Yosef explains a teaching before Rav Pappa.
